section.content: 本实用新型涉及集成电路卡技术领域，且公开了一种半导体集成电路卡，包括卡体、支撑条和上卡条，所述卡体的右端与支撑条的左侧插接，所述支撑条的右端与支撑条的顶部左侧活动连接，所述上卡条的左端活动连接有第一限位条，所述第一限位条的正面螺纹连接有拧柱，所述第一限位条的背面设有第二限位条，所述第二限位条的底端活动连接有下卡条。该半导体集成电路卡，通过设置支撑条、上卡条、第一限位条、第二限位条和下卡条，加固了卡体的四条边，在保持抗折的同时，最大化减小与卡体的接触面积，也便于拆卸，且PET具有耐折，耐磨的力学性能，玻璃增强后的PET，刚性变强，不易折断，解决了当前公交IC卡容易折断损坏的问题。

The utility model relates to an integrated circuit card technical field just discloses a semiconductor integrated circuit card, including the card body, support bar and go up the card strip, the right-hand member of the card body is pegged graft with the left side of support bar, the right-hand member of support bar and the top left side swing joint of support bar, the left end swing joint of going up the card strip has first spacing, the positive threaded connection of first spacing has wrong post, the back of first spacing is equipped with the spacing of second, the bottom swing joint of the spacing of second has down the card strip. This semiconductor integrated circuit card through setting up the support bar, going up card strip, first spacing strip, the spacing strip of second and lower card strip, has consolidated four limits of the card body, when keeping anti book, the maximize reduces with the area of contact of the card body, also convenient to detach, and PET has resistant book, wear-resisting mechanical properties, PET after the glass reinforcing, the rigidity becomes strong, difficult rupture, has solved the problem that current public transit IC card breaks the damage easily.

Semiconductor integrated circuit cardTechnical Field

The utility model relates to an integrated circuit card technical field specifically is a semiconductor integrated circuit card.

Background

The semiconductor integrated circuit card is also called as an IC card, the application of the IC card in life is more, for example, the bus IC card, because the bus IC card is taken out for use, the use scenes are more, most of the use time is used in the time period of getting on the bus, because the riding environment is more complex, the probability of damaging the bus IC card is higher, because the thickness of the card is very thin, the card is extremely easy to wear and break in the use process, and therefore people use the card sleeve to avoid the situation, but the anti-breaking capability of the card sleeve to the bus IC card is not obviously improved.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

Technical problem to be solved

The utility model provides a to prior art not enough, the utility model provides a semiconductor integrated circuit card possesses the advantage of preventing the rupture, has solved the problem that current public transit IC-card breaks the damage easily.

(II) technical scheme

In order to realize the above-mentioned purpose of preventing breaking, the utility model provides a following technical scheme: the utility model provides a semiconductor integrated circuit card, includes the card body, support bar and goes up the card strip, the right-hand member of the card body is pegged graft with the left side of support bar, the right-hand member of support bar and the top left side swing joint of support bar, the left end swing joint who goes up the card strip has first spacing, the positive threaded connection of first spacing has the wrong post, the back of first spacing is equipped with the spacing of second, the bottom swing joint of the spacing of second has lower card strip, the right-hand member of lower card strip and the bottom left side swing joint of support bar.

Preferably, the front face of the second limiting strip is in threaded connection with the rear end of the screwing column, and the screwing column extends to the inside of the second limiting strip.

Preferably, a first protective layer is bonded to the front surface of the card body, and a second protective layer is bonded to the back surface of the card body.

Preferably, the second protective layer and the first protective layer are polyethylene film layers.

Preferably, the front surface of the first protective layer is evaporated with a first insulating layer, and the first insulating layer is a mixed evaporated layer of silicon oxide and titanium dioxide.

Preferably, the back surface of the second protective layer is evaporated with a second insulating layer, and the second insulating layer is a mixed evaporated layer of silicon oxide and titanium dioxide.

Preferably, the lower clamping strip, the second limiting strip, the first limiting strip, the upper clamping strip and the supporting strip are made of glass reinforced PET.

Compared with the prior art, the utility model provides a semiconductor integrated circuit card possesses following beneficial effect:

1. this semiconductor integrated circuit card through setting up the support bar, going up card strip, first spacing strip, the spacing strip of second and lower card strip, has consolidated four limits of the card body, when keeping anti book, the maximize reduces with the area of contact of the card body, also convenient to detach, and PET has resistant book, wear-resisting mechanical properties, PET after the glass reinforcing, the rigidity becomes strong, difficult rupture, has solved the problem that current public transit IC card breaks the damage easily.

2. The semiconductor integrated circuit card has the advantages that the first protective layer, the second protective layer, the first isolation layer and the second isolation layer are arranged, the first protective layer and the second protective layer are impact-resistant and corrosion-resistant, the service life of the card body is prolonged, and the first isolation layer and the second isolation layer are used for protecting the first protective layer and the second protective layer and preventing ultraviolet rays from degrading and oxidizing oxygen.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be described clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only some embodiments of the present invention, not all embodiments. Based on the embodiments in the present invention, all other embodiments obtained by a person skilled in the art without creative work belong to the protection scope of the present invention.

Referring to fig. 1-4, the present invention provides a semiconductor integrated circuit card, which comprises a card body 1, a supporting strip 2 and an upper card strip 3, wherein the right end of the card body 1 is inserted into the left side of the supporting strip 2, the card body 1 can be pulled out from the left side of the supporting strip 2 with a certain force, a first protective layer 8 is adhered to the front side of the card body 1, a first insulating layer 10 is evaporated on the front side of the first protective layer 8, the first insulating layer 10 is a silicon oxide and titanium dioxide mixed evaporation layer, a second protective layer 9 is adhered to the back side of the card body 1, a second insulating layer 11 is evaporated on the back side of the second protective layer 9, the second insulating layer 11 is a silicon oxide and titanium dioxide mixed evaporation layer, the evaporated silicon oxide has excellent barrier property, the barrier property to oxygen and water vapor is very good, the titanium dioxide has good ultraviolet masking effect, therefore, the silicon oxide and titanium dioxide mixed evaporation layer can isolate oxygen and ultraviolet in solar radiation, the first isolation layer 10 and the second isolation layer 11 are used for protecting the first protection layer 8 and the second protection layer 9, the second protection layer 9 and the first protection layer 8 are polyethylene film layers, the polyethylene film layers are impact-resistant and corrosion-resistant, the service life of the card body 1 is prolonged, the first isolation layer 10 and the second isolation layer 11 can avoid ultraviolet degradation and oxygen oxidation, the right end of the support bar 2 is movably connected with the left side of the top of the support bar 2, the left end of the upper card bar 3 is movably connected with the first limit bar 4, the front surface of the first limit bar 4 is in threaded connection with the twisting column 5, the back surface of the first limit bar 4 is provided with the second limit bar 6, the front surface of the second limit bar 6 is in threaded connection with the rear end of the twisting column 5, the twisting column 5 extends into the second limit bar 6, the first limit bar 4 and the second limit bar 6 can be fixed through the twisting column 5, prevent that the card body 1 from droing, the bottom swing joint of the spacing strip of second 6 has lower card strip 7, the spacing strip of second 6, first spacing strip 4, go up card strip 3 and support bar 2 and be glass reinforcing PET, PET has resistant book, wear-resisting mechanical properties, PET after the glass reinforcing, the rigidity becomes strong, difficult rupture, the right-hand member of lower card strip 7 and the bottom left side swing joint of support bar 2.

When using, will block the left side that the body 1 inserted support bar 2, rotate in proper order and go up card strip 3, first spacing 4, lower card strip 7 and the spacing 6 of second to with the laminating of the four sides of the card body 1, twist and move and twist post 5, fix first spacing 4 and the spacing 6 of second.
